_readme: Copy this file to dashboard_config.json and fill in your credentials. dashboard_config.json is gitignored — it never gets committed.

tableau._site_name_note: Leave blank for the Default site, or enter the site contentUrl (e.g. 'EquinixAnalytics')
tableau._pat_note: Create a PAT at: Tableau Server → your account icon → Account Settings → Personal Access Tokens
